name: coc-writing
description: WordNet-powered dictionary and thesaurus completion for coc.nvim
author: SeniorMars <cjh16@rice.edu>

commands.title: Show WordNet definition for word under cursor
Search dictionary for word under cursor
Search thesaurus for word under cursor

coc-writing.debug.description: Show a notification when the WordNet index finishes loading.

coc-writing.filetypes.description: Filetypes where coc-writing completion sources and lists are active.

coc-writing.definitionPointers.markdownDescription:
WordNet pointer symbols shown under each definition in the preview window.

| Symbol | Meaning |
|--------|----------|
| `!` | Antonym |
| `&` | Similar to |
| `^` | Also see |
| `@` | Hypernym |
| `~` | Hyponym |
| `+` | Related form |

coc-writing.definitionMaxSynsets.description: Maximum number of senses shown per word in the definition preview. Common words can have many senses; this keeps the preview readable.

coc-writing.dictionary.enable.description: Enable dictionary completion source (prefix word matching with definitions).

coc-writing.dictionary.filetypes.description: Filetypes where dictionary completion is active. Empty means inherit coc-writing.filetypes.

coc-writing.dictionary.minInputLength.description: Minimum characters typed before dictionary completion triggers.

coc-writing.dictionary.maxItems.description: Maximum number of dictionary completion items returned per trigger.

coc-writing.dictionary.priority.description: Completion source priority. Higher values rank above other sources. Restart coc to apply.

coc-writing.dictionary.list.showGlosses.description: Show a short definition beside each word in :CocList writingDictionary. Disable if interactive search feels slow.

coc-writing.thesaurus.enable.markdownDescription: Enable thesaurus inline completion. Disabled by default — use `:CocCommand coc-writing.searchThesaurus` or `:CocList writingThesaurus` for intentional synonym lookup.

coc-writing.thesaurus.filetypes.description: Filetypes where thesaurus completion is active. Empty means inherit coc-writing.filetypes.

coc-writing.thesaurus.minInputLength.description: Minimum characters typed before thesaurus completion triggers. Higher than dictionary to avoid firing mid-word.

coc-writing.thesaurus.maxItems.description: Maximum number of synonyms returned (completion and list).

coc-writing.thesaurus.priority.description: Thesaurus completion source priority. Restart coc to apply.

coc-writing.thesaurus.mode.markdownDescription:
Which WordNet relations power thesaurus results.

- `focused` — `&`, `^` only; closer to blink-cmp-words defaults and usually less noisy.
- `broad` — `&`, `^`, `+`; includes derivationally related forms.
- `custom` — use coc-writing.thesaurus.similarityPointers.

coc-writing.thesaurus.similarityPointers.markdownDescription:
WordNet pointer symbols used to find similar words.

| Symbol | Meaning | Best for |
|--------|---------|----------|
| `&` | Similar to | Adjectives |
| `^` | Also see | All POS |
| `+` | Derivationally related | Nouns & Verbs |

coc-writing.thesaurus.similarityDepth.markdownDescription:
Depth of similarity traversal.

- `0` — same synset only (direct synonyms)
- `1` — same synset + one layer of configured pointers
- `2` — recurse one more layer

Higher values find more synonyms but are slower.

coc-writing.dictionary.fuzzy.enable.description: Enable approximate prefix fallback when the typed word has no exact prefix matches. Catches common misspellings like 'sincersly' → 'sincerely'.

coc-writing.dictionary.fuzzy.minInputLen.description: Minimum input length before fuzzy fallback activates. Lower values trigger fuzzy earlier but may produce noisy results on short inputs.

coc-writing.dictionary.fuzzy.warmSpellin.description: Build the heavier whole-word spelling correction index in the background after startup. Startup stays fast; spelling fallback becomes ready shortly after load.
Delay in milliseconds before warming the spelling correction index after WordNet loads.

coc-writing.dictionary.includeMultiword.markdownDescription: Include multi-word expressions (e.g. `single-entry bookkeeping`) in dictionary completion. Disabled by default — single words and hyphenated compounds are shown; space-separated phrases are filtered out.
